corrected_content.problem:
![](images/ec/ecd105502fc276297713d3a105db0eb099e8f369e3f4773a78412948ad0870c7.png)

The quarter-circle above is defined by the parametric equations

$$
\displaystyle x = 4\cos θ, y = 4\sin θ.
$$

What is the domain of the parameter $θ$?
corrected_content.worked_solution: The displayed arc lies in the third quadrant, from $(-4,0)$ to $(0,-4)$. In $x=4\cos\theta$, $y=4\sin\theta$, these endpoints occur at $\theta=\pi$ and $\theta=3\pi/2$, respectively. Use $\pi\le\theta\le3\pi/2$.
